data.body: [P2] Keep these overrides scoped to the setup steps. Writing them to `$GITHUB_ENV` disables caller-provided pip configuration and `PYTHONPATH` for `setup_command`, `prepare_command`, and all later job steps, potentially breaking SDKs that use private indexes, custom certificates, or Python tooling. Remove these writes and apply the environment directly to both the Hatch and SAM setup steps; add a workflow test confirming caller hooks retain their environment.
